column2: (7)  Subject  to  the  preceding  provisions  of  this  section,
the Productivity Commission may regulate the procedure to
be followed for the summoning and holding of its meetings
and the transaction of business at such meetings.
144. The Chairperson and members of the Productivity
Commission shall be paid such remuneration in such manner
and at such rates as may be determined by Parliament which
shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund.
145. (1) The seal of the Productivity Commission shall
be as determined by the Productivity Commission.
